definition: This dimension controls how turns are assigned to players and enemies, varying from fixed sequences to dynamic orders based on actions or other game mechanics. It influences the strategic depth and pacing of combat encounters.
exclusion_criteria: Fixed turn order with no variability
Real-time action where turn order is irrelevant
inclusion_criteria: Turn order is determined by player initiative or speed stats
Turn order can change based on specific actions taken during combat
title: Turn Order Variability
